arguments.sql: SELECT job_id, error_message FROM failed_jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the error messages in the failed_jobs table to identify common patterns or root causes. Address the malformed rows to ensure data integrity. Coordinate with the database team to address the pgbouncer connection pool exhaustion issue.
arguments.summary: Investigated the failed jobs backlog and identified 1388 recent failures with 47 malformed rows. The pgbouncer connection pool exhaustion issue was confirmed, as restarting it clears the pool immediately. Further investigation of the failed jobs shows a variety of error messages, indicating potential issues with database connections or job execution. The next steps will involve analyzing the error messages to pinpoint the root cause and addressing the malformed rows.
